SELECT COUNT(*) n, COALESCE(SUM(clis>1),0) ko FROM (
            SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT g.cli_id) clis FROM silver.client s
            LEFT JOIN gold.xref_identifiants x ON x.silver_row_id=s.silver_row_id
              AND x.bronze_row_id=s.bronze_row_id AND x.source_systeme=s.source_systeme
              AND x.source_id=s.source_id
            LEFT JOIN gold.client_unique g ON g.cli_id=x.cli_id AND g._batch_id=s._batch_id
            WHERE s._batch_id=:b AND s.nature_personne='PP' AND s.`identite_normalisee` IS NOT NULL AND s.`prenom_normalise` IS NOT NULL AND s.`date_naissance` IS NOT NULL
            GROUP BY s.`identite_normalisee`,s.`prenom_normalise`,s.`date_naissance` HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT g.cli_id)>0) signatures

SELECT COUNT(*) n, COALESCE(SUM(clis>1),0) ko FROM (
            SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT g.cli_id) clis FROM silver.client s
            LEFT JOIN gold.xref_identifiants x ON x.silver_row_id=s.silver_row_id
              AND x.bronze_row_id=s.bronze_row_id AND x.source_systeme=s.source_systeme
              AND x.source_id=s.source_id
            LEFT JOIN gold.client_unique g ON g.cli_id=x.cli_id AND g._batch_id=s._batch_id
            WHERE s._batch_id=:b AND s.nature_personne='PM' AND s.`identite_normalisee` IS NOT NULL AND s.`cp` IS NOT NULL AND s.`adresse_normalisee` IS NOT NULL
            GROUP BY s.`identite_normalisee`,s.`cp`,s.`adresse_normalisee` HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT g.cli_id)>0) signatures

SELECT COUNT(*) n,COALESCE(SUM(clis>1),0) ko FROM (
            SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cli_id) clis FROM gold.client_unique
            WHERE _batch_id=:b AND `nom_reference` IS NOT NULL AND `cp` IS NOT NULL AND `date_naissance` IS NOT NULL AND `telephone` IS NOT NULL GROUP BY `nom_reference`,`cp`,`date_naissance`,`telephone`) signatures

SELECT COUNT(*) n,COALESCE(SUM(clis>1),0) ko FROM (
            SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cli_id) clis FROM gold.client_unique
            WHERE _batch_id=:b AND `nom_reference` IS NOT NULL AND `email` IS NOT NULL GROUP BY `nom_reference`,`email`) signatures

SELECT COUNT(*) n,
        COALESCE(SUM(NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM gold.contrat_certifie c
          WHERE c.cli_souscripteur=g.cli_id AND c._batch_id=g._batch_id)),0) ko
        FROM gold.client_unique g WHERE g._batch_id=:b
          AND g.statut_client IN ('ACTIF','INACTIF','A_REVOIR')
